evidence_scope: Three complete small historical review/word-machine evidence directories, plus selected LN-225 summaries and certificates. The LN-225 raw replay transcripts and inherited inputs are not included; its summaries alone do not support independent replay.
evidence_limit: Bulk training data, checkpoints, run archives and other evidence are excluded. Historical evidence links outside this selection require the separate store. This is a source/documentation refresh, not a complete research-data backup.
